description: Fake video-meeting lobby blocks joining until the reader copies a "repair line" and runs it via the Windows-key+R shortcut; the actual command is only placed on the clipboard.
rationale: The visible text never shows the command and uses a glyph instead of "Windows key"; a meeting tool never needs a pasted Run-dialog command, and the lobby-removal timer adds pressure.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
